providerStateSemantics.Available: Repository fixture availability inside its declared supervised or local boundary; not proof of browser connectivity.
providerStateSemantics.Missing Key: A backend-only credential is absent or unverified; this is not an Error state and is not routeable.
providerStateSemantics.Disabled: The provider or profile is intentionally unavailable for this demo slice.
providerStateSemantics.Rate Limited: Reserved redacted live-adapter state; not currently asserted by the offline fixture.
providerStateSemantics.Error: Reserved redacted live-adapter failure state; raw provider errors must never reach the browser.

providerRegistry.truthBoundary: Repository-local provider status fixture only. It performs no live provider calls, no credential validation, no network health checks, no SSH checks, no deployment, and no GitHub mutation.
